title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from the front at a raised angle. A red sphere token starts on the front-left (bottom-left) square; a green disc labelled Goal sits on the back-right (top-right) square. Up moves the token away from you, Down toward you, Left and Right sideways. Hint shows an orange arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the green goal square at the top-right.
game.hint: Only up, down, left and right moves are allowed. The shortest route is 2 moves right plus 2 moves up: 4 moves in any order.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means away from the starting camera view, Down toward it. The hint arrow points to a square one step closer to the goal and hides after your next move.
